function.name: view_image
function.description: View a PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP image (max 8 MiB); sends it to the model.

function.name: read
function.description: Batch UTF-8 line ranges after search/glob: 1-based, end inclusive, default 200, max 1000 lines/range. Do not reread unchanged content. Per-file errors; next={file_index,start_line}. Shared max_bytes defaults to 12000.

function.name: write
function.description: Create or overwrite a file. Requires approval.

function.name: edit
function.description: Batch ordered replacements in one file. Each old must be unique, or disambiguated by line_number (1-based, current text, single line). Validate all before one approved write; failure leaves file unchanged. Prefer over full rewrites.

function.name: list
function.description: List one directory with types/sizes; prefer glob for discovery. Default 100 entries/12000 bytes. Pass next as cursor.

function.name: glob
function.description: Recursive file discovery (e.g. **/*.rs, src/**/*.{js,css}). Patterns match full workspace-relative paths. Skips .git/node_modules/target/.i unless include_ignored. Default 100 paths/12000 bytes; pass next as cursor. Max 10000 scanned entries: narrow path.

function.name: search
function.description: Recursive line search; literal/case-sensitive by default. mode=files returns only filenames. regex uses Rust syntax (alternatives combine terms); snippets bounded around matches. glob matches workspace-relative paths. Default 50 hits/12000 bytes; pass next as cursor on unchanged files. Skips binary/oversize (skipped count) and build dirs unless include_ignored. Max 10000 entries/64 MiB: narrow path.

function.name: download
function.description: Prepare workspace files as a ZIP. Defaults to the whole workspace. Browser shows a save link; native saves under .i/downloads/.

function.name: shell
function.description: Run a shell command with timeout. Requires approval. NOT sandboxed.
